dogecoin.text: Wow, I just looked at #dogecoin and our indicators gave a buy signal on it at 0.0633 back on April 10. Its now over 16 cents. Knowing is so much better than guessing.
#dogecoin may have popped 20% earlier but its acting like it wants to break down now. Key support close to being broken. This is starting to looks a lot like a replay of #GME
#dogecoin has intra-day support now at 36 cents that needs to hold. If it can then a run to 50 cents or higher is likely coming. If not, time to take some profits and re-assess.
